long_description: Using the PC tools provided on the GitHub page to convert and prepare your downloaded movies, you can now have a professional looking video library and player with several features such as bookmarking and image stretch/zoom.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
